steps.message: How many to-dos do I have in the 'Health' folder in the Joplin app? Express your answer as just a single number.
Execute: adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i joplin"

arguments.command: python android_env.py adb "adb shell "pm list packages | grep -i joplin""
python android_env.py adb "adb shell "find /data/data -name '*joplin*' -type d 2>/dev/null | head -20""
python android_env.py adb "adb shell "find /sdcard -iname '*joplin*' -type d 2>/dev/null | head -20""
